title: AWS Cost Optimization
description: Identify idle and oversized resources, resize or terminate, verify no impact, repeat for continuous savings

steps.description: Query AWS resources: identify idle (CPU<5% for 14d) and underutilized (CPU<20%) EC2, RDS, ELB resources
Tag all candidates with 'optimize:review' and estimated monthly savings; generate report for approval
Classify each resource as 'safe-to-stop', 'safe-to-resize', or 'requires-approval' based on usage patterns
Stop 'safe-to-stop' instances; monitor for 7 days for any user-reported impact
Resize 'safe-to-resize' instances to recommended family/size; perform rolling replacement
Confirm no application alerts, no increased error rates, CPU now in 40-70% range post-resize
Generate cost savings report: actual vs projected savings; schedule next optimization cycle
